title: Yellow Door Nashville + Airport/Downtown/Opry
description:
PRIVACY and PROXIMITY at the YELLOW DOOR NASHVILLE
Near downtown (15 min), airport (7 min), that Grand Ole place (15 min) , marina (3 min), shopping and interstate (3 min): 1000 sq ft, one level, spa bathroom,  full high-end kitchen, washer & dryer, covered porch, full yard, private parking & fireplace.  Two bedrooms (1 queen, 1 full),  queen sofa bed and queen air mattress to sleep eight.

Perfect for families or couples that want to recharge after a day of sightseeing or a night on the town.

The space
Privacy and proximity.  Home in a residential area just minutes from the AIRPORT (3 mi), OPRYLAND (7 mi), NASHVILLE SHORES WATER PARK (3 mi), ELM HILL MARINA (1 mi) and BROADWAY (9 mi).  With nearly 1,000 sq. ft., the kitchen, dining, and living room are all open to each other - perfect for families or couples. 
On the other half of the house is a large bathroom flanked by both bedrooms, lending privacy to each.  
There is a yard with lots of green space for your furry family members along with a screened in back porch. The yard is not fenced but is private from the road. Free off-street parking, too.
You'll find 'extra' amenities to make your stay comfortable. You will not be disappointed in this adorable place tucked under some big shade trees just minutes from the bright lights of the big city!

Guest access
Entire house and yard.  Private entrance.

Other things to note
The home is a zero lot line residence (townhome). It is completely separate from the only other unit next door with its own parking, yard, and entrances.
